summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a Form 6-K to reschedule its annual general meeting from July 28 to August 6, 2026, and furnish updated proxy materials with an additional proposal. The meeting agenda includes routine items: reappointment of auditors, re-election of directors, approval of CEO/Chairman engagement, and elimination of share par value. The board recommends voting for all proposals. This is an ordinary procedural filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing is a routine notice of shareholder meeting and proxy statement, not a special situation.
